stories.title: Russian ballistic missile strike on Zelenskyy's hometown of Kryvyi Rih kills 2, wounds 60
stories.summary: A Russian ballistic missile hit the center of Kryvyi Rih, President Zelenskyy's hometown, on Friday night, killing a 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old woman and wounding about 60 people, including children. The strike damaged buildings, started several fires and forced an overnight relief center for residents.

stories.title: FBI Ten Most Wanted cartel boss El Chapo Isidro captured in Sinaloa raid
stories.summary: Mexican special forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, alias El Chapo Isidro, in Guasave, Sinaloa with US intelligence support; the FBI had a $5 million bounty on him. The raid set off gun battles, burning vehicles and highway blockades across the region, and two alleged accomplices were also detained.

stories.title: COP31 climate talks deadlocked as fossil-fuel fight pushes summit into overtime
stories.summary: Negotiations among nearly 200 countries in Antalya have slipped into overtime over a draft deal that no longer mentions fossil fuels, with countries split over carbon-capture language. Developing nations are also angry that a pledge to ramp adaptation funding to $120bn by 2035 was dropped from the text.

stories.title: Denmark says it thwarted Russian plot to kill US-Ukrainian rapper Kyivstoner
stories.summary: Danish authorities say their security service stopped a Russian intelligence plot to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper Kyivstoner near Copenhagen in September, and Denmark is expelling a Russian diplomat over the case - a fresh flashpoint in Europe's standoff with Moscow.

stories.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved the Riemann hypothesis with Claude's help
stories.summary: Levent Alpoge, a mathematician at Anthropic, says he produced a Lean-verifiable proof of the Riemann hypothesis - the 167-year-old Millennium Prize problem - working alongside Claude. If verified, it would be the strongest evidence yet that AI can crack problems that resisted generations of mathematicians; the claim is lighting up math circles and Hacker News.

stories.title: Bye-weekend Dawg Chow: Browns sit at 6-4 with seven games to decide their season
stories.summary: Dawgs By Nature's Saturday roundup collects the week's best Browns reads heading into the bye: the Beacon Journal's seven players who will decide the playoff push, Terry Pluto's look at how Todd Monken became head coach, and Harold Fannin Jr.'s growth into a game captain. Next up: the Raiders on Sunday Night Football in Week 12.

stories.title: Browns commentator warns Deshaun Watson may want out after QB dodges extension question
stories.summary: With Watson driving Cleveland's 6-4 start, the quarterback brushed off a question about signing an extension - saying it is up to his agent - prompting a commentator to argue he cannot wait to get out of Cleveland. The contract decision now hangs over a surprise playoff push.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. Nebraska pick: Cornhuskers to cover as No. 14 Buckeyes visit Lincoln
stories.summary: Action Network's game-day breakdown likes Nebraska to cover a roughly 3-point home spread against Ohio State, which is 2-2 on the road this season, with the total around 41.5. It is the Buckeyes' final road game before The Game against Michigan on Nov. 28.

stories.title: Ohio State at Nebraska: live updates as No. 14 Buckeyes try to keep CFP hopes alive
stories.summary: No. 14 Ohio State (7-3) visits Nebraska (6-4) at Memorial Stadium in Lincoln, with kickoff at noon ET on FOX. The Buckeyes sit three spots outside the projected College Football Playoff field, so every remaining game is effectively an elimination game.

stories.title: How to watch Ohio State at Nebraska: noon ET Saturday on FOX and FOX One
stories.summary: Game-day viewing guide: No. 14 Ohio State (7-3), fresh off a 28-19 win over Northwestern, faces Nebraska (6-4), which shut out Rutgers 31-0, at 12:00 p.m. ET on FOX - also streaming on FOX One.

stories.title: Lando Norris brands McLaren awful in the straight despite P3 on Las Vegas grid
stories.summary: Norris qualified third, 0.093s off inherited pole, but tore into McLaren's straight-line deficit - saying the car is shocking in the straights - noting Antonelli's slipstream was worth up to 16 km/h. McLaren trails Red Bull by 17 points in the constructors' fight with three rounds left.

stories.title: George Russell slams Verstappen after Las Vegas practice collision
stories.summary: Russell muscled past Verstappen after the Red Bull forced his way by in final practice, making side-on contact at Turn 14 and earning Verstappen a stewards' warning - Somebody's got to stand up to that guy, Russell said. The two will share the front row in Saturday night's race.

stories.title: Russell tops final Las Vegas practice, seven tenths clear, before Verstappen flashpoint
stories.summary: In the only dry practice session of the weekend, Russell ended FP3 0.7s clear of Norris with a 1m34.041s lap on the slippery Strip circuit, then clashed with Verstappen at the end of the session in an incident noted by the stewards.

stories.title: Antonelli fastest in Las Vegas qualifying, but Verstappen inherits pole; Ferraris out in Q2
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli set the fastest time in Las Vegas qualifying (1m33.893s) for the eighth time this season, but a five-place engine penalty promotes Max Verstappen to pole, with Russell and Norris completing the top three. Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc both failed to reach Q3.

stories.title: NBC4 Season of Giving launches: fill a holiday wish list for a central Ohio senior
stories.summary: NBC4's annual Season of Giving with Besa is underway, inviting residents to fill holiday wish lists for local seniors in need - a program that started with 26 seniors in 2012 and now serves hundreds across central Ohio.

stories.title: Ohio officers start new regional domestic-violence training program
stories.summary: Law enforcement officers across Ohio have begun new regional domestic-violence training funded through the state Office of Criminal Justice Services, an effort to improve and standardize how departments respond to domestic-violence calls statewide.

stories.title: Blue Jackets announce Hockey Tonk country night for Nov. 25 game vs. Devils
stories.summary: The Jackets Jukebox series gets a country twist: the Nov. 25 game against New Jersey at Nationwide Arena will feature live music from BELLES, a mechanical bull and themed entertainment around the arena.

stories.title: Butch Bando's Fantasy of Lights returns with 30+ new displays for year 10
stories.summary: The Central Ohio drive-through holiday light tradition is back with an expanded Blue Jackets display and a first-ever JEGS feature, celebrating 10 years of partnership with A Kid Again, which funds outings for families of children with serious illnesses.
